questions.question: This session already works on <open>. A new session or /clear keeps each effort clean. Continue <next> here?

options.label: Open a new session (Recommended)
options.description: Nothing resumes here. Open a new session or run /clear, then ask to continue it; it picks up there with a clean context.

options.label: Go on here
options.description: It resumes in this session, next to the effort already here.
